agents.tagline: A no-code GenAI accelerator that enables enterprises to build, deploy, and orchestrate intelligent AI agents at scale with built-in governance.
agents.description: ThoughtMesh is a no-code GenAI accelerator platform that enables enterprises to build, deploy, and orchestrate intelligent AI agents at scale. It provides a visual drag-and-drop UI for creating multi-agent workflows, integrates RAG capabilities with corrective validation to minimize hallucinations, and supports knowledge base creation from structured and unstructured data. The platform enforces namespace-driven governance so only authorized users can access underlying data, even across shared workflows. ThoughtMesh reduces GenAI development time by up to 80% through pre-built templates and composable agent components.

use_cases.title: Enterprise knowledge base creation and conversational querying across unstructured documents
multi-agent workflow orchestration for complex business processes
RAG-powered intelligent assistants with hallucination guardrails
no-code AI agent prototyping for business users

expected_outcomes: Up to 80% reduction in GenAI development time
improved data governance through namespace-driven access controls

agents.tagline: An AI-powered modernization accelerator that uses customizable AI agents to analyze legacy codebases, map dependencies, and generate cloud-ready architecture blueprints.
agents.description: NeuVantage is an AI-powered modernization accelerator that uses customizable AI agents to analyze legacy codebases, map dependencies, flag redundant code, and generate modernization blueprints. It employs semantic code chunking and AI-assisted comprehension to replace weeks of manual discovery with automated analysis, producing actionable insights and cloud-ready architecture diagrams. The platform maps modernization paths using the 5R strategy framework (rehost, refactor, rearchitect, rebuild, replace) and can accelerate application modernization by up to 40%. NeuVantage's AI agents are adaptable to specific organizational workflows and technology stacks.

use_cases.title: Legacy application assessment and modernization planning
automated dependency mapping and redundant code detection
cloud migration architecture blueprint generation
technical debt quantification and reduction strategy

expected_outcomes: reduced manual discovery effort through AI-assisted code comprehension

agents.tagline: An AI-powered data warehouse modernization platform with self-healing pipelines that autonomously detect and correct data errors during migration.
agents.description: TrueMorph is an AI-powered data warehouse modernization platform featuring self-healing pipelines that autonomously detect and correct data errors in real time during migration. It uses machine learning to continuously learn from data patterns, predict pipeline failures, and generate reusable validation rules without manual intervention. The platform automatically identifies and masks sensitive information (PHI/PII) while maintaining audit trails and compliance. TrueMorph implements a Medallion Architecture (Bronze-Silver-Gold) with built-in transformation scripts, enabling up to 60% faster migration with minimal downtime.

use_cases.title: Enterprise data warehouse migration to modern cloud platforms
autonomous data quality monitoring and error correction during ETL processes
PHI/PII detection and masking for compliance during data migration
legacy data platform modernization with minimal downtime

expected_outcomes: autonomous error detection and correction reducing manual QA effort

agents.tagline: An AI-assisted vulnerability remediation engine that automates end-to-end detection, prioritization, testing, and patching across enterprise codebases.
agents.description: CVE Copilot is an AI-assisted prefab product that automates end-to-end vulnerability remediation across detection, prioritization, testing, and reporting. It operates as a full-stack engine with four modular AI components: Scanner for vulnerability detection via tools like Trivy and Prisma, Analyzer for risk prioritization, Migration Guide for recommending code changes, and Fixer for deploying patches. The platform supports multiple AI models including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Google Gemini, and can be deployed either as a GitHub Action within CI/CD pipelines or as a standalone SaaS solution. It is designed for mid-to-large enterprises in regulated industries with active DevSecOps practices, targeting Security Engineers, Developers, and CISOs.

use_cases.title: Automated vulnerability scanning and prioritization across enterprise repositories
AI-driven code patch recommendations and deployment
CI/CD pipeline-integrated security remediation
compliance-driven vulnerability management for regulated industries

expected_outcomes: Reduced mean time to remediate vulnerabilities
automated patch generation reducing manual developer effort
continuous security posture improvement through CI/CD integration

agents.tagline: A rapid AI development framework that compresses enterprise AI solution deployment from months to 8-12 weeks.
agents.description: Volt is Q3 Technologies' proprietary Rapid AI Development (RAD) framework designed to accelerate enterprise AI application development. It provides pre-built data pipelines, pre-trained AI models, and integrated DataOps/MLOps workflows that reduce development overhead by approximately 50% and cut costs by up to 40%. The framework leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology to ground AI outputs in proprietary organizational data, and supports agentic architecture for structured reasoning through sequential event processing. Volt includes model evaluation tools with cost prediction functionality, emphasizes data security and AI explainability, and deploys flexibly across cloud, on-premises, or hybrid infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Predictive analytics and forecasting for enterprise decision-making
intelligent AI agents and virtual assistants
multi-modal content generation (text, audio, video)
intelligent document processing and extraction

expected_outcomes: Up to 40% reduction in AI development costs
50% faster delivery timelines (8-12 weeks vs. months)
